name: Rider Bond
body:
Rider Bond (Ex)
Source Cohorts and Companions pg. 9
You and your eidolon share an empathic connection while you ride it. You gain a bonus on Ride checks equal to one-half your summoner level and you also gain Mounted Combat as a bonus feat when mounted on your eidolon. The eidolon must possess the mount evolution to take this evolution.
